articles.title: 2 years on, Kanke Dam park facelift plan hangs in balance
articles.summary: The proposed facelift plan for Kanke Dam park has encountered significant delays, remaining in an uncertain state two years after its initial conception. This vital public amenity project currently hangs in balance, raising questions about its eventual execution and the timeline for its completion for local residents.

articles.title: DC's Supergirl & Lanterns Could Be Essential For Man Of Tomorrow
articles.summary: Casting announcements for DCU's 'Man of Tomorrow' suggest future projects like 'Supergirl' and 'Lanterns' will hold important plot details for the 2027 film. This emphasizes James Gunn and Peter Safran's core vision for the DC Universe, ensuring every film and series is interconnected, contributing to a cohesive and unified narrative across the franchise.

articles.title: James Gunn Gives First Update in Almost 1 Year on Beloved Superhero Team Joining the DCU After Major Rumors
articles.summary: The DC Universe is actively expanding its superhero roster and projects. Upcoming additions include the "Lanterns" series, featuring Hal Jordan and John Stewart this summer, along with new films. This strategy aims to significantly broaden the franchise's presence and introduce more iconic characters to its cinematic and television universe, marking a new phase of content development.

articles.title: Indian Army Major Abhilasha Barak to receive UN Military Gender Advocate award
articles.summary: Major Abhilasha Barak, India Army's pioneering first woman combat helicopter pilot, is set to receive the UN's 2025 Military Gender Advocate of the Year award on Friday. This prestigious recognition honours her vital outreach work and significant contributions. Her achievement highlights India's progress in promoting gender equality within its armed forces and sets an inspiring precedent for women in uniform globally.

articles.title: IAF partners with IIT Bombay to develop ‘health index’ for Su-30 MKI engines
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force (IAF) has signed three contracts with IIT Bombay to develop a health index for Su-30 MKI fighter aircraft engines undergoing midlife maintenance. This collaboration aims to enhance engine diagnostics, improve operational efficiency, and potentially reduce maintenance costs. This strategic partnership highlights India's push for indigenous technological solutions and advanced maintenance practices to ensure higher availability and readiness of its frontline fighter fleet.

articles.title: Defence Ministry Grants Autonomy to New UPDF Referral Hospital
articles.summary: Uganda's Ministry of Defence and Veterans Affairs (MODVA) has finalized plans for the new Uganda Peoples Defence Forces (UPDF) National Referral Hospital. It will operate under an independent corporate governance model to ensure efficient management and high-quality healthcare for servicemen, veterans, and their families. This initiative reflects a commitment to military welfare and modern administrative practices in defence infrastructure development.

articles.title: Govt in damage control over NEET leak, CBSE evaluation row
articles.summary: The government is addressing widespread criticism concerning the NEET paper leak and anomalies in CBSE Class XII answer-sheet evaluation. Signalling a more serious and coordinated response, authorities aim to restore faith in the national examination system. This proactive stance is crucial for maintaining transparency and fairness in higher education admissions, directly impacting aspirants nationwide.

articles.title: China sends defence university delegation to Shangri-La Dialogue for second straight year
articles.summary: China's People's Liberation Army National Defence University will send a delegation to the Shangri-La Dialogue in Singapore for the second consecutive year. This major Asian security summit is a crucial platform for regional defence discussions. Beijing's consistent participation signals its engagement in Indo-Pacific security dialogues, vital for addressing geopolitical tensions and fostering stability.
